document_type: M3-BV benchmark construction lock: candidate grid, reference & headline budgets, replicate RNG rule, label/stability thresholds, oracle definition, selection rule -- committed BEFORE any M3-BV characterization run (task Sec. 5/6/8/9/13/15)

candidate_grid.source: task Sec. 5 recommended scalar grid; frozen event family = the 8 frozen M1-D event configs (same family, NOT the old 24-state benchmark)

reference_evaluation.rng_rule: [701001 + candidate_idx] over states sorted by (config_id, s2) ascending (same pattern as M3-D reference pool)
reference_evaluation.crn_rule: one shared Generator per state across base/shrink/widen within each batch; only the selected component's Cholesky differs
reference_evaluation.estimator: FROZEN eval_proposal_is semantics: w = exp(logp - logq)*1_A; M2 = mean(w^2); L_j = mean((w*1_j)^2); verify M2 = sum_j L_j
reference_evaluation.label_rule: FROZEN label_state(tau=0.01, margin_min=0.05, hold_window=0.03, se_mult=2.0) -> oracle_action / direction_margin_Delta_dir / support

headline_budget.source: frozen final_eval_n = 100000 per arm (M3-G-v1 protocol; the actual headline evaluation budget used by controller evaluation)
headline_budget.semantics: same frozen estimator semantics; matched = the three arms of one replicate share one stream (CRN), replicates are independent blocks

eligibility_rules.WIDEN_SHRINK: label_state returns WIDEN or SHRINK (statistically supported contrasts at >= 2x paired SE AND direction margin Delta_dir >= 0.05) -- both embedded in the frozen label rule
eligibility_rules.HOLD_reference_indifference: frozen hold_window: |widen_over_base| <= 0.03 AND |shrink_over_base| <= 0.03 at reference budget (task Sec. 8.1: within the frozen HOLD tolerance)
eligibility_rules.HOLD_headline_stability: >= 0.8 of the 8 matched headline replicates place BOTH perturbation arms within +-5% of BASE (|widen_over_base| <= 0.05 AND |shrink_over_base| <= 0.05)
eligibility_rules.WIDEN_SHRINK_action_stability: reference action is the realized best action in >= 0.8 of the 8 matched headline replicates

oracle_and_fixed.oracle_per_state: take the frozen reference action: WIDEN arm / SHRINK arm / BASE arm for HOLD
oracle_and_fixed.best_fixed_definition: among the three fixed policies, the one minimizing the global median (median over states of the per-state median over the 8 replicates) of headline M2
oracle_and_fixed.value_metric_per_trial: headline-budget replicate M2 of the acted arm (same property minimized by labels and by M2 estimator)
oracle_and_fixed.aggregation: trial unit = (state, replicate); per-state summary = median over 8 replicates; global summary = median over 24 states

gates.BV0_validity: M3-G-v1 tag exists; task committed before characterization; grid locked; all required arms legal; reference + headline estimators frozen; CRN frozen; M2 = sum L verified; no controller outputs used; full pytest PASS
gates.BV1_sign_diversity: >= 8 stable WIDEN / >= 8 stable SHRINK / >= 8 stable HOLD in the eligible pool
gates.BV2_action_stability: per selected state: WIDEN/SHRINK realized-best fraction >= 0.8; HOLD headline indifference >= 0.8
gates.BV3_oracle_headroom: median_state median_replicate M2(Oracle)/M2(BestFixed) <= 0.95 AND oracle wins >= 16 of 24 states (win = per-state median strictly lower than BestFixed)

hierarchy: 2. maximize config coverage: >= 4 distinct event configs per class AND <= 2 states per (config, class)
3. within equal coverage prefer larger headline-budget stability
selection_rule.algorithm_deterministic: per class: process configs in (config_id) ascending; within each config take eligible candidates sorted by (stability_desc, margin_desc, s2_asc) up to 2; accumulate across configs until 8; if short, fill from remaining eligible candidates by the same sort; selection uses ONLY reference action / margin / stability / legality / config coverage -- no controller performance
selection_rule.if_insufficient: STOP benchmark construction (negative result), report limitation

one_line_state: M3-BV construction lock preregistered; candidate grid 8 configs x 11 s2 values = 88 max; N_ref=500k/arm (20 batches); headline 100k/arm x 8 replicates; no characterization run executed yet
